name: Super Shot
design_intent:
TUTORIAL 2 of 4. WK-123 re-author (CD2-01: after WK-95 a FLY-only pilot cleared v1 in 1.7 s, so the only super tutorial never made you press X). Lesson: PRESS + RELEASE SUPER. The rings sit ABOVE the held-flight ceiling. Holding FLY (lesson 1's verb) visibly runs the tank dry well short of them, and only the super closes the last stretch. Flying up first and then supering is the natural line, and the window is wide: fire anywhere from ~60% down to 10% fuel.

GEOMETRY: one wide trampoline floor (x0-2800, top y1000). Zero stakes: a miss is a soft landing that refunds +20 fuel. Four LANES at x500/1100/1700/2300, each with its own start_gate and gold ring (centre y-3170, 340x360, bottom edge y-2990); any ring counts as HOME. Start_gate order is P1 1100, P2 1700, P3 500, P4 2300, so co-op goats climb 600 px apart and a finished goat falls back down ITS OWN lane, not onto a partner's super (CD2-02 layout fix). A marshmallow ROOF (y-3480) spans the lanes 240 px above the ring tops. It (a) puts the rings inside the camera bounds (camera = platform AABB + 200), so the target is on screen from the first frame; (b) caps the super overshoot, so a finisher bonks and drops straight down its lane; and (c) gives nothing to fly-only players, because an underside contact refunds no fuel and never supercharges. NO side walls, on purpose: wall contacts refund +20 fuel each, so pressing into a wall while flying is effectively infinite fuel, and that would beat any height gate.

MOVEMENT-TOOL ANALYSIS (in-engine, scripted pilots, highest centre y; ring bottom y-2990):
- BOUNCE only: trampoline apex 270 (378 supercharged). Short by ~2700 px.
- HOLD FLY from spawn (the CD2 point-and-go pilot): y-2023 Standard / -2276 Ziggy. Short by 967 / 714 px.
- Best held-flight line (supercharged bounce, coast to apex, hold to empty): y-2361 Standard / -2614 Ziggy. Short by 629 / 376 px.
- SUPER only: about 2450-2870 px of rise. Short by ~1000 px.
- FLY then SUPER (the lesson): clears when X is pressed at <=60% fuel (Standard, from standing) or <=65% (after a supercharged bounce), down to the 10% minimum. Super at 50%: HOME at 3.1 s. Super at 75% or more: short.
KNOWN LEAK (code, reported in WK-123): FEATHERING fly (tapping, 5 ticks on / 10 off) drains fuel only while held, yet still cruises at ~750 px/s. It cleared this course with 40-47% fuel left. No JSON height can fix that.

BOUNDS: explicit; top -4300 sits above the roof.
hint: FLY UP, THEN TAP  X / K  TO SUPER!
